summary_text: Helix International School is an officially recognized Edexcel Approved Centre that offers academic programs from preschool up to IGCSE, OSSD, and secondary levels. The school follows the British curriculum and provides various extracurricular activities alongside online class options. Additionally, it features security gates to prioritize student safety and maintains multiple campuses in Yangon.
